description: Source code for AmlV4L2Device class handling V4L2 device interactions, dynamic library loading, and device management for media encoding on Raspberry Pi 4.

classes.name: AmlV4L2Device
classes.description: Class managing V4L2 device interactions, including initialization, opening, closing, memory mapping, and polling for media encoding.

methods.name: Ioctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl operation on the device, with special handling for encoder type.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls the device for events, with special handling for encoder type.

methods.name: Mmap
methods.description: Memory maps a buffer for the device, with special handling for encoder type.

methods.name: SetDevicePollInterrupt
methods.description: Sets a device poll interrupt, with special handling for encoder type.

methods.name: ClearDevicePollInterrupt
methods.description: Clears a device poll interrupt, with special handling for encoder type.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device, dynamically loads required libraries, and creates context.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the device for a specific type and pixel format.
